title: Porting billions of MapReduce events to Spark and counting only compute
summary: A telecommunications company's summit session on converting Hadoop MapReduce event-processing jobs into Spark jobs on Databricks, with a reported 30 percent compute-cost reduction and no other figure visible.

sources.title: AT&T's Migration of Billions of Events Processing From Hadoop - Data + AI Summit 2024 | Databricks
sources.context: Conference session page; treated as customer-presented from the title, presenter names not visible in the snippet.
sources.caveat: Search-result title and snippet only; the page body was not fetched in this build (egress blocked). Reported outcomes are the reporter's claims, not reproduced results.
